description: Demazure-fiber Markov-trace evaluator: replaces the manual Hecke-energy LP cost vector by Kashiwara weight-lattice projection.  For every Weyl element w ∈ S_n and partition λ ⊢ n, computes the Demazure character D_w(λ), the principal-specialisation ratio D_w/D_{w_0}, and the Demazure-fiber Markov-trace functional T^Dem(λ; w) = y_λ · D_w(λ)/D_{w_0}(λ).  At w = w_0 reduces to the standard Markov trace; at shorter w gives the structural Demazure resonance width.
